summary: Nora now reads each room's own account of itself (its culture) in every turn and background pass, not only when she decides to join in unprompted.
details: The daily culture account of a room now reaches the tagged reply, reminders and other scheduled turns, the proactive pass, both note passes and both standing folds.
Passes that look across several rooms see one account per room, named by the room's label.
The relevance gate still does not read it.
Turning `[culture] enabled` on changes these prompts; there is no separate read switch.
limitations: A room that has not been folded yet has no account, so the block appears room by room over the first day after enabling.
Whether the account improves each occasion's decisions is measured per occasion after landing; an occasion that reads worse with it is removed.
